page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at the lower right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: spondit, si nihil ex peculio a-pud patrem remanserit, non repetiturū: nam manere naturalem obligationem argumento esse, quòd extraneo agente intra annum de peculio, deduceret pater quod sibi filius debuisset. cōtrà, si pater quod filio debuisset, eidē emancipato soluerit, non repetet: nam hic quoque manere naturalem obligationem, eodem argumento proba-tur, quòd si extraneus intra annū de peculio agat, etiam quod pater ei debuisset computetur.
Controuersia nunc altera proponi-tur superiori simillima, & plane ge-mina, ut in ea disceptanda nihil prope

page.notes: The first word "spondit" is printed with a long-s form that looks like f; read as s per rule. The catchword "negocij" sits at lower right. "ut in ea disceptanda nihil prope" appears in a heavier or different type; not marked as italic because the type is uncertain. The running head and page number are partly unclear and marked [?]. Small stray marks near "eodem" and right margin are not printed text and were left out.
